scope: Saved arrays, byte equality, original quality/force/PHR gates, authenticated compact G0 and accounting. CPU only; no Torch, simulation, AD, cache callback or timing replay.
limitations: Live mutation-version identity checks are source-reviewed and supported by authenticated CPU tests/logs, not independently instrumented during the GPU run.
Intermediate accepted velocity/density are not saved; their finite/min statistics remain producer records. Final fields are saved and checked.
Qualification proof omits full frames; this audit recomposes scalar PHR/FD from authenticated q/constraints and saved gradients, not new AD.
Saved timings are checked arithmetically, not remeasured. One execution does not establish statistical performance. T07 and T08 worker walls have different G0 policies.
Memory counters are Torch allocator/cached payload, not process-wide CUDA peak memory.

crossRun.interpretation: Cross-run byte equality is an observed equivalence result, not a predeclared correctness gate. Differences prohibit a byte-identical trajectory claim; within-run paid-final equality remains mandatory.
